test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **these**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires **a demonstrative pronoun** to refer to something already mentioned in the context.
 
• '**These**' is the appropriate option as it refers to something plural and close in distance.
 
• Grammatically, '**these**' is a plural form of '**this**' which is used to refer to something close in distance.
 
 
• **For example**: *I love these shoes, they are so comfortable.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

Complete passage: *Astronomers have discovered 62 new moons orbiting the ringed planet Saturn. Though some of the moons had been (1) spotted __as early as 2019, it takes more than sighting an object close to a planet to (2) __confirm__* *it is a moon and not an asteroid making a brief close passage to that planet.*

*Performing a painstaking (3) __process__ of matching objects detected on different nights over the course of 24 months, the team tracked 63 objects that they ended up confirming as moons. One of (4) **__these __**satellites was revealed back in 2021, with the remaining 62 moons gradually announced over the past few weeks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• '**That**' is used to refer to something singular and far in distance.
 
• '**Those**' is used to refer to something plural and far in distance.
 
• '**This**' is used to refer to something singular and close in distance.
